description: This map displays a geographic area within Italy, showcasing a single Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) Natura 2000 (N2K) Area of Interest (AoI) (shaded pale blue) that covers several distinct Natura 2000 sites. The boundaries of the individual Natura 2000 sites are outlined in cyan within the larger pale blue AoI. Each individual N2K site is labelled with a unique identifier code, typical for Italian Natura 2000 sites: IT5340010, IT7110128, IT6020025, IT7120201, IT7120213, and IT7110202. The presence of multiple site codes within a single AoI illustrates how the CLMS N2K product coverage can aggregate several Natura 2000 sites, highlighting the removal of individual site codes from the N2K AoI to prevent misinterpretation of aggregated data. The white areas represent regions outside the defined N2K AoI. No scale bar, compass, or explicit legend is visible.
